title: Israel Has Not Returned to the Lord

questions.question: Hear this word, you cows of Bashan, who oppress the poor, who crush the needy, who say to your husbands, "Bring, that we may..."?
questions.explanation: Amos 4:1 (ESV): "who say to your husbands, 'Bring, that we may drink!'"

questions.question: The Lord God has sworn by his holiness that... they shall take you away with hooks, even the last of you with what?
questions.explanation: Amos 4:2 (ESV): "even the last of you with fishhooks."

questions.question: Come to Bethel, and transgress; to Gilgal, and multiply what?
I gave you cleanness of teeth in all your cities, and lack of bread in all your places, yet you did not do what?
questions.explanation: Amos 4:6 (ESV): "yet you did not return to me,"

questions.question: Prepare to meet your God, O Israel!
questions.explanation: Amos 4:12 (ESV): "prepare to meet your God, O Israel!"

questions.question: Bring your sacrifices every morning, your tithes every three days; offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving of that which is what?
questions.explanation: Amos 4:5 (ESV): "offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving of that which is leavened,"

questions.question: I withheld the rain from you when there were yet how many months to the harvest?
questions.explanation: Amos 4:7 (ESV): "when there were yet three months to the harvest;"

questions.question: I struck you with blight and mildew; your many gardens and your vineyards, your fig trees and your olive trees the what devoured?
questions.explanation: Amos 4:9 (ESV): "your fig trees and your olive trees the locust devoured;"

questions.question: I sent among you a pestilence after the manner of whom?
questions.explanation: Amos 4:10 (ESV): "I sent among you a pestilence after the manner of Egypt;"

questions.question: I overthrew some of you, as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, and you were as a brand plucked out of the what?
questions.explanation: Amos 4:11 (ESV): "and you were as a brand plucked out of the burning;"

questions.question: Through what part of the wall shall they go out?
questions.explanation: Amos 4:3 (ESV): "And you shall go out through the breaches, each one straight ahead;"

questions.question: Where shall they be cast forth?
questions.explanation: Amos 4:3 (ESV): "and you shall be cast forth into Harmon,"

questions.question: Proclaim freewill offerings and publish them; for so you love to do, O people of Israel!
questions.explanation: Amos 4:5 (ESV): "Proclaim freewill offerings and publish them; for so you love to do, O people of Israel!"

questions.question: He who forms the mountains and creates the wind, and declares to man what is his thought, who makes the morning darkness, and treads on the heights of the earth—who is he?
options: The Lord, the God of hosts
questions.correctAnswer: The Lord, the God of hosts
questions.explanation: Amos 4:13 (ESV): "the Lord, the God of hosts, is his name!"

questions.question: So two or three cities would wander to another city to drink water, and would not be satisfied; yet you did not return to me.
questions.explanation: Amos 4:8 (ESV): "So two or three cities would wander to another city to drink water, and would not be satisfied;"

key_verse_text: Therefore thus I will do to you, O Israel; because I will do this to you, prepare to meet your God, O Israel!
